# Copilot instructions

## "Learn it"

When the user says "learn it", load and follow [`.cursor/rules/learn-it.mdc`](../.cursor/rules/learn-it.mdc). It records the lesson from the latest change as a do or don't in UX writing or UX patterns. That file is canonical. Do not duplicate its rules here.

## Carry it across

Before any UI change, load and follow [`.cursor/rules/carry-across.mdc`](../.cursor/rules/carry-across.mdc). A change to an element on one page applies to every page that shows the same element.
